❤️🐾 My heartfelt thanks to the Vetnasa team and Dr. Geovane! 🐾❤️

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the entire Vetnasa team and, especially, to Dr. Geovane, for the care, attention, and dedication with which they looked after my Theozinho and Nico 🐶🐶❤️

In a moment of so much worry and anguish, it was very important to have professionals who demonstrated care, patience, competence, and love for our four-legged children.

Those who love their pets know that they are part of the family, and finding people who treat them with so much affection makes all the difference.

Thank you so much for all the care, support, and attention! May God bless each of you and continue to illuminate this beautiful mission of caring for those who cannot speak, but feel all the love in the world. 🙏🏻🐾❤️

With love and gratitude! 🌷
The animal acquired at this location arrived with illnesses, and the establishment did not cover the veterinary costs.

Beware of a scam!!!!!
They are super helpful when selling the dog, they give you attention, until you buy.
The dog arrived sick, they disappear on weekends, and if your dog is between life and death, they will only respond on Monday. All the receipts and proof of payment were sent, every step taken was reported. More than two months have passed and they haven't reimbursed any of the medication used.
The dog was defecating blood all over the house. I had to give it deworming medication, and they say they don't reimburse deworming medication.
They make many promises and don't keep them in the end!!! Don't fall for this scam!!

Dr. Daniela was very attentive to my dog ​​during his hospitalization. But after 2 days in the hospital, he came out in terrible hygienic conditions, with feces all over his body. Can you imagine the hygienic conditions he was in while hospitalized??
Considering it's a private hospital, where the cost is high, I think it's absurd to discharge a dog in these conditions. It's regrettable.

Hello, Marcelo!

Thank you for your feedback! Your trust means a lot to our entire team. You can always count on us to take care of your pet's health and well-being! 💙🐾

Vetnasa Bandeirantes Team 💙🌟🐶
Accurate, quick, and empathetic consultation. Dr. Dani was very welcoming.
Excellent service and professionals! I highly recommend them!!!
